records.original_stem:
A reconstituted product has a short labeled in-use period. Its unopened manufacturer's expiration is months away, and the patient's prescription remains valid for the rest of the year.

Which conclusion follows? Select ONE answer.

original_choices.text: Limit use of the prepared product to its applicable in-use period.
Refrigerating the product restarts its manufacturer's expiration.
The prescription's annual validity becomes the prepared product's BUD.
A refill authorization permits use after the product's in-use limit.

A.original_option_text: Limit use of the prepared product to its applicable in-use period.
A.finding_ko: 재구성 전·후 expiration 정보를 별도로 표시하게 하는 규칙과 부합한다. 제시된 labeled in-use 기간을 적용하며 실제 기간 숫자를 새로 추정하지 않는다.

authorities.effective_date_status: Current consolidated section read; section commencement/amendment effective date was not separately reconstructed. Currency bounded by publisher display.

explanation_review.core_reasoning_original_ko: 처방 유효기간, 제조사 expiration, preparation-specific BUD/in-use, days supply를 따로 판단한다.

A.finding_ko: 재구성 전·후 expiration 정보를 별도로 표시하게 하는 규칙과 부합한다. 제시된 labeled in-use 기간을 적용하며 실제 기간 숫자를 새로 추정하지 않는다.

B.finding_ko: 저장조건은 안정성시험과 연계되며 냉장 행위가 날짜를 재시작시키지 않는다. 냉장이 요구되는 제품인지도 이 문항에는 없다.

C.finding_ko: 처방 사용가능기간은 제조자가 정한 재구성 후 stability기간의 근거가 아니다. Annual validity를 BUD로 바꾸는 비교 자체가 잘못이다.

D.finding_ko: 추가 공급을 허용하는 refill과 이미 재구성한 제품의 stability는 별개다. 기존 제품 사용기한이 연장되지 않는다.

explanation_review.learning_boundary_original_ko: 한 판단을 위한 개별 작성 사례. 기존 원칙을 더 명확한 사례로 연습하며 새로운 법규 96개 또는 최근 기출의 재현이라는 뜻은 아닙니다.

realism_review.finding_ko: 무명 product의 short period를 그대로 따르는 A만 합리적이다. B 냉장 재시작과 D refill로 안정성 연장은 실제 competing clock보다 상식적 소거가 쉽다. 가장 가까운 REV0090은 ingredient eligibility 문제여서 실질 중복은 없지만 둘 다 confirm형 선택지가 유일하게 신중한 답이다.

records.required_next_action_ko: 실제 허가 label이 있는 재구성 제품·조제일·인쇄된 expiration·남은 supply를 제시하고 어느 날짜를 환자에게 안내할지 결정하도록 재작성한다.

records.original_stem:
A prescriber requests non-child-resistant packaging for one prescription. The patient has made no blanket request covering other prescriptions.

How should the pharmacy apply that request? Select ONE answer.

original_choices.text: Treat it as permission to reuse any returned prescription container.
Apply the prescriber's request to this prescription, not future orders.
Apply it only if the patient is older than a fixed age threshold.
Apply it to every prescription from every prescriber for that patient.

A.original_option_text: Treat it as permission to reuse any returned prescription container.
A.finding_ko: 특정 처방의 conventional packaging 요청은 모든 반환 용기를 재사용하는 권한이 아니다. CPSC의 특수포장 재사용 금지 설명도 별도로 적용된다.

A.finding_ko: 특정 처방의 conventional packaging 요청은 모든 반환 용기를 재사용하는 권한이 아니다. CPSC의 특수포장 재사용 금지 설명도 별도로 적용된다.

B.finding_ko: CPSC는 prescriber standing instruction을 해당 처방의 refill에는 적용하되 같은 환자의 다른 처방까지 넓히지 말라고 명시한다. Future orders는 새로운 처방으로 읽는다.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacist compares products with the same active ingredient but different release formulations. The insurer prefers the lower-cost immediate-release tablet over the prescribed extended-release tablet.

What is the appropriate approach? Select ONE answer.

original_choices.text: Substitute if the patient signs an insurance-coverage acknowledgement.
Check exact interchangeability before changing release formulations.
Substitute immediately because both contain the same active ingredient.
Keep the original label's extended-release wording on the substituted immediate-release product.

records.original_stem:

original_choices.text: A clinical query eliminates the pharmacy's future reporting obligation.
A successful upload automatically documents every pharmacist's clinical query.
Any employee with reporting access may inspect any patient's history for personal interest.

records.original_stem:
At pickup of a new prescription, a trained cashier asks whether the patient would like to speak with the pharmacist. The patient says yes and asks whether the medicine can be taken with a supplement. A pharmacist and a supervised pharmacy intern are available.

Which response appropriately completes the next step? Select ONE answer.

original_choices.text: Refer the medication question to the pharmacist or supervised intern.
Record counseling as completed because the patient accepted the offer.
Have a certified technician assess the supplement because the prescription is verified.
Have the cashier read the interaction section from the pharmacy leaflet.

A.original_option_text: Refer the medication question to the pharmacist or supervised intern.
A.finding_ko: 훈련된 designee는 offer할 수 있으나 실제 counseling은 pharmacist/intern이 한다. 환자의 supplement interaction질문은 이 인력에게 연결한다.

records.original_stem:

Which response best respects the scope of the patient's permission? Select ONE answer.

records.original_stem:
A fully qualified Massachusetts technician immunizer is working under the required pharmacist supervision. A patient asks which of two products is appropriate for a previously undocumented reaction. The pharmacist has not selected the vaccine or counseled the patient.

What should occur before the technician proceeds? Select ONE answer.

original_choices.text: The technician should use national certification as authority to decide independently.

The cashier should obtain a refusal of counseling so the technician can choose.

original_rationale_review.finding_ko: 이미준비된 제품은 적합성/금기평가를 대신하지 않는다. Technician이 임의로 고르는 근거가 아니다.

option_reviews.original_option_text: The cashier should obtain a refusal of counseling so the technician can choose.

original_rationale_review.finding_ko: Cashier의 counselingrefusal취득은 technician의 scope를 확대하지 않는다. 실제reaction평가/제품선정은 pharmacist에게 남는다.

option_reviews.original_option_text: Have the pharmacist assess the reaction, select the vaccine, and counsel.
option_reviews.finding_ko: 약사가 reaction을 평가하고 vaccine을 선택/상담한 뒤 적격technician이 preparation/admin을 수행해야 한다. III(D)(4)의 순서에 맞다.

authorities.effective_date_status: Posted policy expressly revised9/4/25;adopted5/4/23.

original_rationale_review.finding_ko: 약사가 reaction을 평가하고 vaccine을 선택/상담한 뒤 적격technician이 preparation/admin을 수행해야 한다. III(D)(4)의 순서에 맞다.

authorities.effective_date_status: Posted policy expressly revised9/4/25;adopted5/4/23.

explanation_review.learning_boundary_original_ko: 한 판단을 위한 개별 작성 사례. 기존 원칙을 더 명확한 사례로 연습하며 새로운 법규 96개 또는 최근 기출의 재현이라는 뜻은 아닙니다.

realism_review.finding_ko: 기술적투여자격과 미완료clinicalassessment가 충돌하는 실제예방접종시나리오다. 선택된제품준비상태와refusal로 권한을 만들려는 오해를 구분한다. 비교 REV0008은 intern조제finalverification이므로 scope경계는 유사해도 legalact는 다르다.

records.required_next_action_ko: D키 유지. Technician의 모든자격을 새로열거하지 않고 stem의 fullyqualified전제를 보존한다.

records.original_stem:
A vaccine is administered and an event meeting an applicable VAERS reporting requirement occurs. The pharmacy has entered the administration into MIIS.

Which statement best describes the reporting relationship? Select ONE answer.

original_choices.text: The pharmacy should delete the MIIS entry before submitting VAERS.
Report the adverse event through VAERS as well as recording the MIIS dose.
The MIIS entry serves as the required VAERS submission if the lot number matches.
VAERS submission must wait for proof that the vaccine caused the event.

records.original_stem:
A supervising physician refers an adult patient for retail CDTM. The pharmacist has the referral and the original consent remains in the physician's record. The physician asks when the consent copy must be sent to the pharmacist.

Which deadline applies to this communication? Select ONE answer.

original_choices.text: Within 48 hours.
Within 7 calendar days.
Within 72 hours.
Within 24 hours.

A.original_option_text: Within 48 hours.
A.finding_ko: 48시간이 아니라16.03(5)(d)(2)는 physician의 consentcopy전송을24시간으로 명시한다.

authorities.effective_date_status: Current Mass.gov posted 247CMR16 bears MA Reg1354 dated2017-12-15; individual commencement history not separately reconstructed.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacist sees a boxed warning and a required Medication Guide for a drug. No current enrollment requirement has been established from the drug's current REMS materials.

What additional conclusion can be drawn from the boxed warning alone? Select ONE answer.

original_choices.text: The pharmacy must create an enrollment record before dispensing any refill.
The prescriber must obtain a DEA waiver for this drug.
The warning alone does not establish an enrollment requirement.
The pharmacy may omit the Medication Guide if no enrollment program exists.

A.original_option_text: The pharmacy must create an enrollment record before dispensing any refill.
A.finding_ko: Boxedwarning은 seriousrisklabeling이다. 그것만으로 everyrefill의 enrollment조건을 만들수없고 clozapine제거사례도 이를직접보여준다.

explanation_review.learning_boundary_original_ko: 한 판단을 위한 개별 작성 사례. 기존 원칙을 더 명확한 사례로 연습하며 새로운 법규 96개 또는 최근 기출의 재현이라는 뜻은 아닙니다.

realism_review.finding_ko: 확인된theft와장기investigation이주어져초기서면통지와후속completedreport를분리해야한다. C의investigationend는현실적인지연오해다. 비교 REV0078은biennial대reconciliation으로둘의무구별형식은비슷하나trigger/기관/기한이다르다. Canonical비교결함: Q0058도미완료investigation과1businessdaywrittennotice+45dayForm106을묻는다. Significantloss대confirmedtheft의사실차이가있으나여기서는모두보고trigger를충족해같은two-clock답을되풀이한다.

records.required_next_action_ko: B키 유지. Notice는1businessday이고Form106은discovery부터45days라는현행원문을유지하며MA별도보고를이문항의연방키에합치지않는다. 기존canonical근접문항과하나만기본학습에남기거나새로운예외·행위가필요한사례로재작성한다.
